title: Count the Vowels
description:
# Count the Vowels

This program is supposed to read a line of text and print how many **vowels** (`a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, `u`, any case) it contains.

But it has a bug. Find and fix it so the tests pass.

## Input

A single line of text.

## Output

The number of vowels.

```
Input:
hello

Output:
2
```
starterCode:
line = input().lower()
vowels = "aeiou"
count = 0
for ch in line:
    if ch == vowels:
        count += 1
print(count)
